constraints: This is verification of readiness, not launch authorization or submission approval.
The Operator must independently pass fresh host-lock, idle-device, memory, disk, inode and clean-source preflight gates on each host.
Only one job may run per host; dual execution is permissible only because the requests target distinct hosts.
The launcher inherits ambient variables beyond the explicitly bound request environment. Do not inject hostile LD_PRELOAD, XLA, TORCH or equivalent variables.

Remote ready-to-retrieve status is not local durability. Retrieve and hash-verify requests, runtime jobs, pre/postflight, logs, metrics, manifest, archive, completion and checkpoint receipts before analysis.
Any crash, NaN, timeout, budget failure, dirty source, postflight failure, count mismatch, checkpoint mutation or artifact mismatch invalidates that host's control.
No pruning, cache cleanup, retry, leaderboard submission or causal win claim is authorized.
